title: Hold Span Loading on Remobilization Fees — Professional Services Projects
content:
For a fixed-fee Professional Services Projects engagement resumed after a client-caused hold longer than the class hold limit, the span of the hold adds re-ramp weeks and quarterly remobilization to the remobilization fee.

## Clause

For the hold, the remobilization fee rests on the hold length, the calendar days from the on-hold date to the resumed date, and on the full months on hold counted the same way, a whole month being complete only on the same day number of a later month. A hold shorter than one and a half times the class hold limit is charged the class remobilization fee; a hold of one and a half times the class hold limit or longer adds to that 250.00 for every full week by which the hold exceeds the class hold limit; a hold of twice the class hold limit or longer adds to both a further class remobilization fee for every 3 full months on hold, pro-rated by full months, so that a longer hold never costs less to restart than a shorter one. What a hold is charged under this clause is the remobilization fee before deduction.

| Hold length | Remobilization fee before deduction |
|---|---|
| shorter than one and a half times the class hold limit | the class remobilization fee |
| one and a half times the limit or longer, shorter than twice it | the class remobilization fee plus 250.00 for every full week of the days on hold beyond the limit |
| twice the limit or longer | the class remobilization fee plus 250.00 for every such full week, plus the class remobilization fee multiplied by the full months on hold and divided by 3 |

A full week is seven whole days; a part week beyond the last full week adds nothing.

## Class figures

| Engagement class | Hold limit (days) | One and a half times | Twice | Class remobilization fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Assessment Engagement | 30 | 45 | 60 | 0.00 |
| Quick Start Project | 30 | 45 | 60 | 250.00 |
| Standard Project | 45 | 67.5 (68 days or more) | 90 | 500.00 |
| Advanced Project | 60 | 90 | 120 | 1000.00 |
| Major Project | 90 | 135 | 180 | 2500.00 |
| Strategic Program | 90 | 135 | 180 | 5000.00 |

## Worked case (hypothetical figures)

An Advanced Project held from 10 January to 12 July of a year that is not a leap year: 183 calendar days and 6 full months. The hold exceeds the 60-day limit by 123 days, which is 17 full weeks, adding 4250.00; it is twice the limit or longer, adding 1000.00 multiplied by 6 and divided by 3, that is 2000.00. With the class fee of 1000.00 the amount before deduction is 7250.00.
